Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the label information after viewing the Wikipedia page for “Power,” incorrectly asserting that My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was not a Roc-A-Fella release. Despite earlier and corroborating evidence from Discogs and Wikipedia showing “Power” (featuring Dwele) and MBDTF were released under Roc-A-Fella/Def Jam, the Planner overrode the correct conclusion and prematurely finalized the answer as Graduation.
